Bybit Dubai entity secures VASP license from VARA for spot crypto trading

Bybit announced on October 22 that its Dubai entity, Bybit Fintech FZE, had secured a Virtual Asset Service Provider (VASP) license from Dubai's Virtual Assets Regulatory Authority (VARA), covering spot crypto trading. Bybit established its international headquarters in Dubai in 2022 and received in-principle approval in 2024. Other exchanges holding VARA licenses include Binance, OKX, Gate and Backpack. — link

U.S. Bitcoin ETFs Draw $528 Million, Ether ETFs Add $15 Million

According to SoSoValue, U.S. spot Bitcoin ETFs recorded $528 million in net inflows on October 21, led by BlackRock's IBIT with $235 million. Spot Ethereum ETFs attracted $14.96 million, with Grayscale's Ethereum Mini Trust (ETH) posting the largest inflow at $28.07 million. BlackRock is the world's largest asset manager, while Grayscale is a leading crypto-focused asset manager. — link

Grayscale has announced In-kind Investing, allowing eligible investors to exchange digital assets directly for shares in its products without first converting their crypto into cash. The service currently covers 10 products involving BTC, ETH, SOL, AVAX, LINK, DOGE, HYPE, SUI, XRP, and ZEC.
